title: Arthur Fery just did something Wimbledon hasn't seen since 2001
text:
British darling Arthur Fery has reached the Wimbledon semifinal and will face his toughest test yet in Alexander Zverev.
, entered the men's singles draw as a wild card. The 23-year-old British player upset Flavio Cobolli in straight sets on Centre Court on Wednesday, July 8, to become the first male wild card to reach a Wimbledon semifinal since 2001.
"In the Open era, there had been only three other men's wild cards to reach the semifinals at any major: Jimmy Connors , Henri Leconte and Goran Ivanisevic ,"Fery's fate will be decided on Friday, July 10. For now, the hometown darling is enjoying a dream run.
"I always believed in myself and believed that I could be a top player in the world, but obviously, semifinalist of Wimbledon is something else," Fery said in. "I've taken it match by match. I haven't looked ahead. I've just played every match as it is, and yeah, here I am.
", but he is"starting to" grasp the weight of being the last British player standing at Wimbledon. Imagine how electric Sunday's final will be if Fery has a shot at becoming the first Brit to win Wimbledon since Andy Murray in 2016.
